blocks.html: An Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) is a detailed description of the type of company that is the best fit for a business’s product or service. It defines key characteristics such as industry, company size, revenue, location, and buying behavior to help sales and marketing teams focus on high-value, high-conversion prospects.

An ICP helps businesses identify organizations most likely to benefit from their solution and become profitable long-term customers. Unlike buyer personas, which focus on individual decision-makers, an ICP focuses on company-level attributes. It is widely used in B2B sales and marketing to improve targeting, increase efficiency, and shorten sales cycles.
Companies build an ICP by analyzing their best existing customers and identifying shared traits such as:

items.html: Company size by employees or revenue

blocks.html: Sales and marketing teams then use this profile to prioritize outreach, campaigns, and account-based strategies.
Improves lead quality and conversion rates
Helps focus efforts on high-value accounts
Reduces wasted time and acquisition costs
Shortens the sales cycle through better targeting

A SaaS company identifies its ideal customer profile as healthcare organizations in North America with 200–1,000 employees, growing compliance needs, and an annual technology budget above ₹5 crore. The company then targets similar businesses in its outreach campaigns.

An Ideal Customer Profile is a critical foundation for efficient revenue growth. By clearly defining the companies most likely to buy and succeed, businesses can improve targeting, win better customers, and scale faster.
